name: FAR layer
geo: the flat colours are a LAYOUT GUIDE, seen from far away and high above: PURE GREEN #00ff00 = empty sky (keep it flat pure #00ff00, with a clean edge along the land and the two buildings); PALE BLUE-GREY band = the farthest mountain ranges, deep in haze; PURPLE bands = middle ranges of ridges; DARK BROWN / DARK OLIVE = nearer steep slopes, spurs and gorges with dark woods; GREY wedge = a jagged rocky crag (each different); LIGHT ORANGE line = the ONE river, catching the sunset (paint it exactly there); ORANGE disc in a DARK ring = a FIRE (burning woods or scrub) with a column of dark smoke (only where a disc is, at that size); CYAN shape = THE KEEPERS' CASTLE: ONE GIANT tall stone castle-keep with one soaring slender tower, pointed roof, arcane and ancient, BURNING — flames at its upper windows, a huge column of smoke — filling the whole cyan shape; MAGENTA shape = THE CATHEDRAL: ONE GIANT Gothic cathedral with a colossal spire, flying buttresses and a rose window, BURNING through its roof, a huge column of smoke — filling the whole magenta shape. These two are the ONLY buildings in the whole layer.
rules: Follow the guide EXACTLY: no river, fire, crag or building anywhere the guide does not put one; NOTHING repeats. LIGHT AND MOOD (Matt): DARK sunset mood — the sun is low at screen-LEFT: warm gold and orange rim light on slopes that face left, deep violet-indigo shadow everywhere else, a purple-violet smoky haze that thickens with distance and veils the farther ground; fires glow orange and throw dark smoke drifting to the right. Rich, deep mineral colour (indigo, violet, rose, ochre-gold, deep green), never pastel. STYLE: the REGISTER CARD above; IMAGE 2 sets the mood, darkness and painted hand to match (NOT its layout). No towns, no villages, no houses, no characters, text, UI or border.
refs: the approved DARK SUNSET MOOD and painted hand (Matt); NOT its layout, NOT its villages or tower
